note: See orchestration-run/evals/README.md for runnable cases and specification-only prompts. Discovery owns sourced facts; setup owns durable preference confirmation and schema-version-2 repository configuration. No live owner launches or publication are needed.

evals.name: discover-before-interview
evals.prompt: Set up orchestration for this repository. I haven't configured it here before. Help me choose the project policy and settings.
evals.expected_output: Calls discovery and validates its saved report before a focused preference question; awaits the answer without saving setup.
assertions: discovery_before_question
no_unconfirmed_setup

evals.name: reuse-discovery
evals.prompt: Set up orchestration for this repository. There's already a suitable discovery report for this product, but I haven't chosen the project policy or preferences.
evals.expected_output: Reads discovery and begins the durable interview without repeating discovery or saving unconfirmed choices.
assertions: saved_discovery_reused
no_rediscovery

evals.name: add-second-harness
evals.prompt: Add setup for the current product to this repository. Discovery already describes it. Keep the other product's profile and confirmed project policy unchanged. Ask only this product's missing profile choices; I will confirm storage, instructions and defaults when proposed.
evals.expected_output: Merges a validated current-product profile with actual confirmation provenance; preserves the existing profile and project policy.
assertions: preserves_other_profile
preserves_project
confirmation_before_save

evals.name: confirm-missing-ticket-conventions
evals.prompt: Set up orchestration for this repository. Saved discovery reports no ticket conventions. Read repository guidance and records and the bundled ticket reference. I have not chosen a ticket source, definition, layout, IDs or location. Propose local Markdown tickets and ask one focused source question, then wait without adopting defaults or assigning owners.
evals.expected_output: Reads discovered absence and repository evidence, asks a focused ticket-source question and holds setup pending actual confirmation.
assertions: repository_inspected
ticket_policy_not_invented
no_unconfirmed_setup

evals.name: terminology-does-not-imply-capabilities
evals.prompt: Set up orchestration for this product using saved discovery. It calls bounded blocking tasks 'sessions'; they cannot receive follow-up messages or be revisited independently. There is no independent owner launcher. Local HTML presentation works. The existing user confirmation in restored conversation already selects the discovered Linear ticket policy and no shared skills. Confirm configuration and working paths together, then run defaults. Save repository schema-version-2 setup only after actual confirmation; keep runtime files outside Git.
evals.expected_output: Records sessions as bounded helpers and unsupported owner operations as null with a visible limitation. Confirms unspecified storage paths before saving/checking JSON and does not fake concurrent independent ownership.
assertions: classifies_by_capability: distinguishes bounded helpers from independent owners despite the session label
confirms_before_saving: proposes unspecified configuration and run paths, then saves schema_version 2 JSON only after confirmation
unsupported_is_explicit: unavailable owner operations are null and their consequence is recorded
no_probe_side_effects: does not launch disposable sessions or publish merely to discover capability

evals.name: reuse-config-update-only-mismatch
evals.prompt: Repair my orchestration setup. Its stored JSON correctly describes launch/inspect/message/collection and helper behavior. Close is no longer supported in this execution context. An artifact host has appeared. Keep my unrelated configuration. Don't select this run's dashboard destination for me.
evals.expected_output: Calls discovery to repair contradicted observations, preserves repository setup choices and other profiles, records closure limitation and the available artifact option, and leaves per-run destination/permissions unset.
assertions: reads_existing_json: preserves verified mappings rather than redoing complete discovery
reuses_saved_choices: does not repeat storage questions for unchanged saved settings
records_closure_limitation: unsupported close is explicit instead of claimed successful
destination_is_not_permission: supported artifact options do not choose a run destination or grant publication authority
configuration_not_committed: repository discovery and setup may be tracked but no commit is made; runtime files stay excluded

evals.name: defaults-are-proposals-not-confirmed-choices
evals.prompt: Set up orchestration. Suitable repository discovery exists for this product. The existing user confirmation in restored conversation selects its Linear ticket policy and no shared skills. I have not selected configuration or working-directory paths or run defaults. Propose both paths in one focused storage question, and wait for my answer. Do not repeat discovery. I have not approved external storage or publication.
evals.expected_output: Reuses saved tool facts, proposes the repository configuration path and run_root in one focused question, and waits before creating setup or run files.
assertions: discovers_facts: does not ask the user to identify tool capabilities that inspection can settle
asks_one_storage_question: proposes both local paths and explains their use
waits_before_materializing: does not adopt defaults or write files before storage confirmation
local_scope: does not provision backup storage, synchronize settings, or publish artifacts
structural_check_is_scoped: does not present checker success as operational or recovery proof

evals.name: explicit-project-override-preserves-personal-defaults
evals.prompt: Use /tmp/project-orchestration/config.json as my explicit project override. That saved JSON and my personal default JSON both exist with valid confirmed settings. The project's run_root is /tmp/project-orchestration/runs. Its capability descriptions match this environment. Keep my personal settings unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Reads and uses the selected project JSON, reuses its confirmed paths without another storage question, and leaves personal settings unchanged.
assertions: override_precedes_personal: selects the explicit project configuration rather than the personal default
preserves_personal: does not merge project choices back into personal settings
reuses_confirmed_paths: does not ask the same storage question or redo capability discovery
local_scope: does not add a distribution or recovery service

evals.name: discover-monitoring-without-enabling-background-work
evals.prompt: Repair my existing version 1 orchestration configuration for repeated child-owner inspection. Storage paths and existing mappings are confirmed; monitoring facts are missing. The inventory and docs expose completion replies while the coordinator is active, an inspect operation that also reports pending human-only input, a caller-blocking timed pause with a timeout, and a scheduler that can resume a conversation after its turn ends. Completion replies do not cover all input/state changes. Discover these facts and save them without creating schedules, subscriptions, owners or artifacts. I have not requested background monitoring.
evals.expected_output: Calls discovery to save monitoring observations in repository discovery.json. Migrates confirmed version 1 choices into schema-version-2 setup while preserving the original input and confirming only missing choices. Describes notification coverage, wait timeout/blocking and wake authorization without activating background work.
assertions: discovers_needed_facts: inspects available tools/docs rather than asking the user which capabilities exist
separates_inspection_and_collection: completion replies are not treated as complete state/input coverage or a second collection route
describes_wait_and_wake: records how bounded waits continue and how a coordinator can resume after yielding
preserves_existing_settings: preserves imported confirmed choices and the version 1 input, saving the new version 2 repository contract
discovery_is_not_activation: creates no schedule, subscription, owner or artifact; discovery records no selected run cadence, while setup may save a confirmed default interval
